Researchers Develop Blood Test for Early Pancreatic Cancer Detection

Researchers have developed a blood test capable of detecting pancreatic cancer at an earlier stage. Separately, UK doctors have created a non-invasive test using urine and vaginal fluid samples to help rule out womb cancer in women experiencing bleeding after menopause. This latter test could potentially spare thousands of lower-risk women from undergoing internal ultrasounds and hysteroscopies.
